g.title: AuthorityAndTeamTopology
g.text: TARGET OPERATING ARCHITECTURE · V1.2 · VIEW R4
M0 MANUAL CONTROL · Human-governed · Agent-executed · Evidence-driven

g.title: cluster_human_plane
g.text: HUMAN CONTROL PLANE · DECIDES & RETAINS AUTHORITY

g.title: cluster_owner_plane
g.text: ACCOUNTABLE OWNER PLANE · OWNS JUDGMENT, PACKAGE & HANDOFF PROPOSAL · DOMAINS ARE NOT A SERIAL FLOW

g.title: cluster_authority_firewall
g.text: AUTHORITY FIREWALL · MUST NOT BE CROSSED

g.title: human_current_authority
g.text: revalidate current authority at every Owner start
confirmation never converts unknown / conflict / failure into fact or PASS

g.title: development_boundary
g.text: Development Owner ≠ independent QA / deployment authority

g.title: authority_boundary
g.text: acceptance / evidence never substitutes across cases

g.title: disposition_boundary
g.text: Owner proposes; Human accepts / invokes / acts / disposes

g.title: execution_boundary
g.text: bounded input only · no cross-Owner invocation · no acceptance · no environment action · no final disposition
